the reflection mode XAFX method is a promising tool for the investigation of thin film systems with a low density of absorbing atoms, which are difficult to investigate in the transmission mode.

the XAFS technique can be used as a sensitive tool to monitor the short range atomic order and to determine the coordination numbers in amorphous thin films.
